description: This file defines the RestRequest class in the StashApi namespace, providing methods for creating and executing REST API requests using cURL, including support for different HTTP methods, request body construction, and connection management.

classes.name: RestRequest
classes.description: A class to handle REST API requests via cURL, supporting different HTTP verbs, request body building, and response handling.

methods.name: openConnect
methods.description: Initializes connection parameters and prepares request body if needed.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the REST request, handling connection setup, request method, and cleanup.

methods.name: buildPostBody
methods.description: Creates request body content, including handling file uploads or JSON encoding.

methods.name: getResponseBody
methods.description: Returns the response body from the executed request.

methods.name: getResponseInfo
methods.description: Returns the response info in array form (e.g., HTTP status code).

methods.name: lastRequestStatus
methods.description: Returns true if the last request was successful based on HTTP status code.

methods.name: doExecute
methods.description: Performs the actual cURL execution for the request.

methods.name: setCurlOpts
methods.description: Sets the necessary cURL options for the request, including timeouts, headers, and proxy settings.

methods.name: setAuth
methods.description: Sets HTTP Basic Auth credentials if provided.
